phase: Input-placement test. The PROMPT is identical in both arms; only where the wallet rule is written differs. v3/v4 showed three prompt-sentence changes in a row doing nothing, so this asks whether placement is what binds.
primary: Same pre-registered outcome as v4: on-arm reachability against the candidate's own seed spread, with an off-arm rise counted as a failure. Only grant and local_voucher cells can move - cashback has no wallet and its terms are already in the conditions block.
limitations: Twelve people, four seeds. Precision for these twelve, not generalisation.
Cashback and distancing cells carry no wallet_acceptance, so they are unchanged by construction and act as a within-run placebo.
Reaching is necessary, not sufficient: it means the policy can be measured, not that the day moved correctly.
Same prompt (v25). The wallet rule is stated in the conditions block instead.
preflight: 277 unit checks passed including 6 new resource-gate regressions. Source, v25 and asset_transaction_v7 unchanged from the previous round.
selection: Closed pair fixed before the run (experiments/v5/prompt_v5.md). The two arms differ only by surface_wallet_acceptance; enforced by test_surface_acceptance.py.
